description: Momentary and short-term loudness (LUFS), width and balance per frame, from tools/dsp-descriptors-vectors.py. Frames end at samples 2048 + 512 k of one segment. Channel c of sample n is sign * 10^((gain_db + offset_db) / 20) * sin(2 pi frequency_hz n / sample_rate_hz) + dc, where offset_db cycles through levels ([samples, offset_db] pairs; none means 0) and a null gain_db is silent. Rows are [momentary_lufs, short_term_lufs, width, balance]; null width and balance mark windows whose mean left/right energy is at most 1e-08. Nominal values hold from frame from_frame within nominal_lu (loudness) and nominal_ratio (width, balance).
